name: empirica
description: Empirical-convergence workflow — adjudicates a claim graph (GSN argument with in-toto evidence) where every claim's confidence must be earned by real external evidence: research citations first, deterministic spike verdicts for machine-checkable claims, then an independent auditor before a run may report convergence. Hook-enforced on supported Codex lifecycle surfaces.

interface.longDescription: Adjudicate a claim graph with cited research, deterministic spikes, and independent audit before reporting convergence.
